title: Angry people
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What usually makes people angrier: the event itself or the feeling that they were treated unfairly?
Is showing anger sometimes useful, or does it usually make problems worse?
How can you tell when someone needs space rather than advice?
Should people be judged for what they say when they are extremely angry?
What is the healthiest way you know to calm down before responding?
